messages:
alex: quick heads-up — on 2 sm_86 machines I'm seeing ~12% higher token latency for seqlen 4096 vs baseline. traces point to kernel path change around kv-cache refill. detection says bf16 available but kernel uses fp32. anyone seen misreported capability flags? :thinking:

maya: which model? small/medium? can you paste the device probe output + driver?

alex: repro on gpt2-small and llama-7b both. probe dump:
```
GPU 0: sm=86, driver=535.54, tensor_cores=true
cap_flags: bf16:true fp8:false tf32:false
autokernel: preferred=tc_gemm_bf16 fallback=matmul_fp32
runtime_probe: fastpath_check=PASS (heuristic)
```

alex: but perf counters show 0 TC ops, matmul avg FLOPS matches fp32 path

runtime-bot: note: rollout v1.33 -> runtime nodes marked with probe=true at 1965127000

juan: hmm — our probe heuristic checks driver >= 535 && sm>=86 => enable BF16 fastpath. There are known driver-level bugs that expose BF16 but disable TC accel for some kernels. need microbench to confirm HW accelerators

sophie: can we add a startup microbench that runs a small GEMM with bf16 inputs and times it, writing result to /var/lib/redwood/node-probe.json? That would confirm actual fastpath

juan: +1. also we should gate kernel selection by both capability_flags and a runtime perf-check bit. sequence-length gating already flips kernel at >2048; maybe the threshold should consider throughput delta rather than hard seqlen

alex: repro command i'm using:
```
export REDWOOD_RUNTIME_PROBE=1
./redwood_probe --check=bf16 --seq=4096
```

maya: can you run `nvprof --metrics sm__inst_executed_pipe_tensor_cycles` or `nv-nsight` microbench? if tensor cycles are 0 then it's emulated

alex: will run both on the two bad hosts and paste results later

infra-bot: created issue INF-4021 (runtime: add microbench fastpath probe + store flag); assign juan

juan: I'll add a quick kernel that does bf16 GEMM with cuBLASLt and record time/ops. If slow, flip capability_flags.bf16=false at runtime and fall back to matmul_fp32 path

sophie: also add metric emission to /metrics/kernel_choice{kernel="tc_bf16"|"matmul_fp32"} and sequence_len histogram. Helps detect regressions quickly

alex: thanks. if we flip flag dynamically, we should avoid thrash — only change once per reboot or when infra-bot forces reprobing

maya: maybe add a bias toward fastpath if microbench within 15% of expected FLOPS, else stick to conservative path

alex: will run tests and report numbers in this thread. pinging @infra for help getting ssh access :eyes:

sophie: thanks — this should prevent future misreported-capability perf surprises :thumbsup:
